sources.title: Sentiment Analysis of Arabizi Tweets
sources.snippet: This paper presents a deep learning approach for sentiment and emotional analysis of Lebanese Arabizi tweets, focusing on data from the 2019 social unrest and the economic crisis of 2020. The authors created and labeled a dataset of 46,000 Arabizi tweets, achieving high F1 scores of 81% for binary sentiment analysis and 64% for 3-class sentiment classification.
